differences.shared_517: Transformer FP16; UMT5 CPU FP32, max_sequence_length=512; prompt embeddings cast to GPU FP16
differences.official_native_observed: Transformer, UMT5 and VAE GPU BF16; max_sequence_length=512 from WanPipeline.__call__
differences.required_change: Add explicit transformer dtype to shared worker/loader/casts and runtime identity; choose one encoder dtype and placement profile for every common-backend port. Preserve original native runs separately.
differences.not_sufficient: Change47a98a7 makes the CPU text encoder BF16 but leaves the DiT and GPU prompt embeddings FP16; it is not present in frozen517 and does not establish an all-BF16 or CPU/GPU numerical equivalence.

differences.shared_517: CPU torch.Generator(seed), FP32 latents transferred to GPU
differences.official_native_observed: Generator on pipe._execution_device, currently CUDA with no offload; FP32 latents
differences.required_change: The disclosed common port must use the same CPU generator/FP32 latent preparation as the shared worker, or receive the same prepared latent; record initial latent SHA. The same integer seed on CPU and CUDA is insufficient.

differences.shared_517: Actual formal P0 configs select flash -> SDPA_FLASH for DiT; finish/async VAE uses a MATH context; chunked low-precision VAE permits flash/efficient/math
differences.official_native_observed: r3 post-request self/cross selector CUDNN; declared SDPA_EFFICIENT fallback. No per-call dispatch proof and no explicit common VAE context.
differences.required_change: Pin the same self/cross backend and VAE context in every common port; run a MATH diagnostic when needed and the intended SDPA_FLASH production path. Record fallback/actual selector separately from requested configuration; require dispatch evidence before claiming identical kernels.

differences.shared_517: Formal P0 VAE BF16. latent/mean/std FP32 inverse-normalization then cast to VAE dtype; decoded tensor cast to FP32 before postprocessing. Chunked and whole decode use this same recipe.
differences.official_native_observed: VAE BF16. Diffusers0.36 casts latent and mean/std to VAE dtype before inverse-normalization and forwards the VAE result to postprocessing.
differences.required_change: Use one explicitly versioned decode recipe for common whole/segmented/native ports; compare raw final latent, inverse-normalized VAE input, raw decoded tensor and postprocessed frames. The shared helper docstring claiming exact official arithmetic is not valid for low-precision VAE normalization.
differences.finite_boundary: Finite postprocessed float frames can hide pre-clamp infinities; uint8 finiteness proves still less. Check pre-clamp decoded tensors and latent separately.

differences.shared_517: Request-local UniPC cloned from bound checkpoint; solver_order2; separate conditional/unconditional forwards; CFG u+g*(c-u)
differences.official_native_observed: Single-transformer WanPipeline/UniPC; checkpoint-bound flow_shift explicitly supplied by adapter, Wan21=3 and Wan22=5; same CFG formula
differences.required_change: Keep full scheduler config and record actual timesteps/sigmas and installed scheduler source SHA. Preserve complete UniPC solver history across pause/migration. Do not silently change Wan21 720p flow_shift to5 from an example; a change requires a separately versioned model recipe.

differences.shared_517: Formal shapes are480x832x81,720x1280x81,512x896x121,704x1280x121;50steps,G5; model-specific spatial multiple checked
differences.official_native_observed: Adapter passes exact formal shape, explicit negative prompt and step/guidance/seed; official Wan22 defaults736-high but adapter overrides to704. Diffusers can round invalid temporal lengths.
differences.required_change: Freeze actual geometry and manifest-pinned VAE factors: Wan22 TI2V-5B revision b8fff7315c768468a5333511427288870b2e9635 has temporal factor4 and spatial factor16, requiring4k+1 frames; its 1701-byte vae/config.json SHA256 d996c340fe9a7df5d7371f76a7d8d6956f6c98256080074d8434fa5eeac11360 was checked against model manifest02ac66402d23a0ad25fa9fece1f6f57e2dc08783dda18ff4c9904fddf28d2c5f. Validate preprocessed and decoded shape, prompt/negative bytes,512-token limit and attention masks. The existing native CLI uses explicit empty negative for its single-request diagnostic; a replay port must preserve each exported request negative verbatim.

differences.shared_517: Reduced/modified xfuser wrapper supports block execution, request-local state, regroup and pipeline references fed with shared prepared embeddings/latents
differences.official_native_observed: Complete official runner and monolithic pipeline, no DitServe scheduler
differences.required_change: Keep the native oracle immutable. Build a separately named common-backend port with complete original/derived inventories and imported-file hashes; preserve each external scheduler/batching/communication. Internal reference with shared embeddings/latents is an arithmetic check, not independent native preprocessing validation.

proposed_common_profile.preferred_precision: BF16 transformer and BF16 UMT5; BF16 VAE with one chosen normalization/decode recipe; FP32 solver latents and CPU RNG
proposed_common_profile.encoder_placement: Choose one placement for the controlled common-backend comparison. A CPU/GPU placement optimization may be evaluated separately with the same precision, numerical tolerance, and full host/GPU time and memory accounting.
proposed_common_profile.compatibility_profile: If retaining517 unchanged for an immediate common-backend port, every port must instead adopt its FP16 DiT / CPU FP32 encoder / BF16 VAE recipe and label it explicitly. Do not mix this with native BF16 results.
proposed_common_profile.runtime_identity: Pin model manifest, protocol, full scheduler config, tokenizer files, dtype/device per component, RNG device, attention selector/fallback, decode recipe, shared source inventory and actual installed library file hashes.
proposed_common_profile.dependencies: No new package or image is implied by these source-level alignment changes; existing fixed-image numerical validation is still required.
